manualReview: All five queued account read/write publication paths use a shared in-flight deletion fence; synchronous normalization only uses current cache.
Fence covers deletion on empty cache and multiple deleted IDs, releases on success or failure, and permits a later authoritative same-ID result.
Balance helpers preserve locked canonical balances and keep PF settled PNL independent; returned balances use synchronized records.
Recharge acquires profile KEY SHARE before player FOR UPDATE and money_logs FK; full ACCOUNT retains its strong profile lock.
Failed recharge log insertion rolls back both balance and log; queued account errors preserve cache and allow later operations.
Matcher cache/version/invalidation, empty-list behavior, PM fields and ended lifecycle rechecked through the existing PostgreSQL suite.
